pages.text: $(bold)Create$() tracks, stations, schedules and signals, extended by $(bold)Steam 'n' Rails$(): conductors, handcars, couplers, track switches, fuel tanks, and a locomotive palette.$(br2)Trains are $(bold)Tier 2$() (Ferrous Wroughtnaut). Tracks need brass casing; brass needs Tier 1.
A station names a stop; a schedule tells the train where to go and what to wait for. Depots (Trading Floor) let a train trade at a town.
The handcar is a rail bicycle: no engine, no fuel, two players pumping. The first thing to build on a new line.

The dream the survivors remembered: a line from the capital to the mountain mine, a dock at the river, a depot in every town, ore moving while everyone sleeps.$(br2)Build the roadbed before the Blueprint. Track is fast to lay once you can.
